note: Weakley County publishes no zoning districts service. City of Martin (largest city) publishes its zoning map only as static PDF (2022/2024 Martin Zoning Map) plus a zoning ordinance; City of Dresden publishes only a 2013 static PDF zoning map. County EMA maps are static PDFs with no zoning layer. ArcGIS Online/Hub searches for Weakley/Martin/Dresden/Greenfield zoning returned no zoning feature services; only parcel and unrelated layers. Zoning is available only as PDF images, so viewer-only.
